INGREDIENTS

• Flour
• Water, about 70%
   – warm, not hot
   – filtered if possible
• Salt
   Use fine salt.

3. Mix everything.
4. Wait.

Run bake --dry-run first. Water is H₂O, the area is r², and s_i is the i-th sample. The 1st loaf was ~perfect~ fine.

def bake(t):
    if t > 250:
        return 'burnt'
    return "ok"

$ make bread
